capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Estimated: 60.0 kWh nominal, CATL LFP (EV Database 2021-23 RWD; the existing OpenEV import for the 2026 Premium-I also shows 60/57). evspecifications lists 62 kWh for 2023-24, Wikipedia 64 kWh for the current RWD. EV Database page is the European Dec 2021-Oct 2023 RWD; NA 2022 RWD (CA and US) assumed to carry the same CATL LFP pack (model-file note says LFP RWD timing unconfirmed). Not verified for North America.

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Estimated: 57.0 kWh usable (EV Database estimate). EV Database page is the European Dec 2021-Oct 2023 RWD; NA 2022 RWD (CA and US) assumed to carry the same CATL LFP pack (model-file note says LFP RWD timing unconfirmed). Not verified for North America.

chemistry.notes: Estimated: LFP (CATL); evspecifications 2023/2024 RWD LFP. EV Database page is the European Dec 2021-Oct 2023 RWD; NA 2022 RWD (CA and US) assumed to carry the same CATL LFP pack (model-file note says LFP RWD timing unconfirmed). Not verified for North America.

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Estimated: 400 V architecture (EV Database); evspecifications 345 V nominal. EV Database page is the European Dec 2021-Oct 2023 RWD; NA 2022 RWD (CA and US) assumed to carry the same CATL LFP pack (model-file note says LFP RWD timing unconfirmed). Not verified for North America.

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: Tesla's release note (2020.24.6.4, Model S/3/X/Y) says the car preconditions its battery when navigating to a fast charger; this is a software feature delivered to the whole Model 3 line (2022 RWD). Page mentions no manual battery-warming control. A manual control was neither found nor ruled out: Tesla's owner's manual pages were blocked (403) and scheduled-departure preconditioning in search excerpts is cabin-oriented.

dc_max_kw.notes: Estimated: 170 kW (EV Database; evspecifications 2023 and 2024 RWD 170 kW; InsideEVs Highland: RWD 170 kW unchanged). EV Database page is the European Dec 2021-Oct 2023 RWD; NA 2022 RWD (CA and US) assumed to carry the same CATL LFP pack (model-file note says LFP RWD timing unconfirmed). Not verified for North America.
